lines.en: Old bones walk slow, but steady.

lines.zh: 这条腿是旧版留下来的。
lines.en: This leg is a leftover from the old build.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐，照样追得上你。
lines.en: I limp, and still catch up with you.

lines.zh: 别催，旧版没有快跑代码。
lines.en: Do not rush me; the old build had no sprint code.
My robe is torn; I cannot be bothered.
Every step feels like counting old debts.
I circle you along the old route.
My knees creak; that is normal.
I know the paths on the old map.
I walk slowly, but my axes fly fast.
I count my axes; not one is missing.
The update remade me all wrong.
Life in the old build was so simple.
I sharpen axes more carefully than teeth.
They say I am out of date.
These hands still remember the old rhythm.
No axe rain, just accuracy.

lines.zh: 我坐在石头上歇一会儿。
lines.en: I sit on a rock for a short rest.
A hole in my hood lets the wind through.
The new Freakager took my job.
I wipe the rust off the axe blade.
Nobody watches me in the old code.
I still keep that Bag of Horrors.
Be quiet; let me think of the old days.
Sweat has polished the axe handle.

lines.zh: 我数着墙上的裂缝，当年也有。
lines.en: I count the cracks in the wall; there were some back then too.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，是没见过的脸？
lines.en: Staring at me? Have you never seen this face?
This face only exists in the old build.
Look closely; do not mistake me.
Your eyes say you pity me.
The moment I lift my head, you shrink back.

lines.zh: 旧标本也是这么看我的。
lines.en: Old specimens looked at me just like that.
Do not size me up with new eyes.

lines.zh: 我们对着看，谁先动谁输。
lines.en: We hold our stare; whoever moves first loses.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛见过太多版本。
lines.en: These eyes have seen too many versions.
Are you calculating how much weaker I got?
Turn around; let me see your teeth.
You watch me; I watch your neck.
The old wound split open again.
These bones can still take it.
The pain makes me grimace.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我虎口发麻。
lines.en: That blow numbed the grip of my old hand.
You hit my old injury.
I take a breath and steady myself.
My robe has torn open once again.
No light blow, that one; it stays in my memory.
I fall back half a step but stay up.
Old body, new pain.
The old me did not fall for this either.
Bread? My teeth gave out long ago.
Waving food at me like I am a dog.
I had a sweet tooth when I was younger.

lines.zh: 这味道唤醒不了旧胃口。
lines.en: That smell cannot wake my old appetite.
Keep the food away; it draws bugs.

lines.zh: 我更想吃你手里的东西。
lines.en: I would rather eat what is in your hands.
Hand the meat over; let me look at it.
Do not trick an old man with new gimmicks.
Eaten; do you have anything else?

lines.zh: 撞我这把老骨头，图什么？
lines.en: Why shove these old bones?
You knocked an axe out of my grip.
Back up; the old build had a temper.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，都退了两步。
lines.en: We collided and both staggered back.
You stepped on my dragging hem.
Stop pushing; I do not stand well.
That shove had the old force in it.
I put a hand on the stone wall.
You are in the way; move aside.
The impact echoes through the cave.
At my age, I no longer do that.
The old build never gave me a partner.
Breeding is not in my code.
I only want to pass on my craft.
A partner? I would rather find a good axe.
My kin were all patched away.
Do not matchmake for me; it is a bother.
Alone, with axes for company.
I believed in such things when young.

lines.zh: 旧版没有婚礼，只有斧刃。
lines.en: No weddings in the old build, only blades.

lines.zh: 地上的破铜烂铁，我看看。
lines.en: Let me look at that scrap on the ground.
This nail can still be used.
Bending is hard for me, but worth it.
I keep every drop from the old build.
That iron belongs in these old hands.
My bag is worn; I will stitch it.
I pick up half a broken axe.
The smaller the item, the easier to lose.
This junk will last one repair.
My hands are full; leave it there.
New face, old rules.
You entered my old territory.
I raise my hand and throw one axe.
Chasing people is familiar work.
Do not think speed is enough.
I enter you in the old ledger.
These hands recognize you.
Prey confirmed; the chase begins.
I take the old shortcut.
You stepped on a stone I placed.
The axe is warm in my grip.
Do not look back; looking back slows you.
One axe is enough; I save my strength.
The old me never shouted warnings.
Your iron shines brighter than the old days.

lines.zh: 这次我提前把斧摸出来。
lines.en: This time I draw the axe ahead of time.

lines.zh: 村口那条路，我以前守过。
lines.en: I used to watch that road by the village gate.
I don't shout; shouting spoils my aim.
I raise the axe and pause half a beat.

lines.zh: 你往后挪，我的斧头跟着挪。
lines.en: As you shuffle back, my axe keeps pace.
This axe aims at your knee.
My aim is crueler than the remake's.
Do not expect me to rage.

lines.zh: 旧版没有斧雨，只有连投。
lines.en: No axe rain in the old build, just quick throws.
Axe after axe, without pause.
Breathe slower and the hand steadies.
Counting how many axes I have left?
I save the last one for you.
Perfect distance; hold still.
The old killing intent remains.
When I squint, you are in danger.
This throw uses all my old strength.

lines.zh: 我抬手的动作比斧先到。
lines.en: My raised hand arrives before the axe.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后面，我换一只手。
lines.en: You hide behind a post, so I switch hands.

lines.zh: 我的影子拖得长，你就慌。
lines.en: My long shadow is what rattles you.
One more step back and you hit the wall.
This throw expects you to duck.
Don't count my axes; you'll lose track.
The axe bites into your shield.
Old arms can still swing heavy blows.
That one had the old build's feel.
As you pull back, I add another axe.
I catch you across the calf.
The axe is stuck; I wrench it free.
Stop dodging and let me land it.
Blood splashes my old boots.
That swing came half a second late.
Old wounds make my hand shake.
The axe back cracks your ribs.
I grin and pull the axe back.
You take cuts better than I expected.
One more, just one more.
The old door opened once more.
I crawl out of being forgotten.
The patch did not delete me cleanly.
This place has changed a lot.
I still wear the robe from back then.
The axe in my bag has not rusted.
Who called me back this time?
Old grudge, new place.
I plant my feet and scan around.
Dust settles on my shoulders.
I have carried this Bag of Horrors all along.
No rage needed, nor wanted.
Three counts, and then I make my move.
The old build is back to collect.
I walk out of an old save.
Nobody wears this outfit anymore.
I still know the road in the fog.

lines.zh: 斧袋的绳结，我打了三十遍。
lines.en: I tied the axe-bag knot thirty times.

lines.zh: 新版的风吹不到我这儿。
lines.en: The new version's wind doesn't reach me here.

lines.zh: 我一站定，稻草就不敢动。
lines.en: I stand still, and even the straw stops moving.
Flames catch the hem of my old robe.
That fall woke my knees again.
Water chokes my throat; unpleasant.

lines.zh: 火光把我整个人掀到墙上。
lines.en: The fireball threw me bodily into the wall.
An arrowhead buries in my shoulder.
This spell does not know the old build.
Hunger makes my arms too heavy to lift.
Lightning hits my axe; my arm goes numb.
The void pulls at me and will not let go.
